name: ztest
description: zOne QA and Playwright E2E testing: review a feature's code and audit its live UI in the browser with a team of tester agents, including the ui-auditor agent, and fix the bugs found by severity (/ztest:qa); design, write and run a Playwright suite for a feature (/ztest:feature); run an existing suite, fix test defects and rerun (/ztest:e2e). Every run ends in a PDF report
